CustomField.description: How the child Capacity Filter rows combine, written the same way Flow writes it, e.g. 1 AND 2 AND (3 OR 4) where each number is a filter's Filter Number. Leave blank to AND every filter together. Only the numbers present on the child rows, the words AND and OR, and parentheses are accepted.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: e.g. 1 AND 2 AND (3 OR 4). Blank means AND everything.
CustomField.label: Filter Logic
